audit.methodology: C5 frozen SciFact full-gold KD FAIL. C6 frozen 971-query official test, 24 fits and 3 seeds; Terra recomputed 6 gates and their paired query-bootstrap CIs. H6b low-gold pass does not isolate teacher information because K10 uses all train slates and G10 cycles the small gold subset; G10 is worse than A0. Multiple machines and one output-sync duplicate race pose provenance uncertainty. P5 Wave2 BGE conditional helps bridges, hurts comparison; best-single-shot comparison CI fields internally inconsistent. Independent reviewer after 15:12 resets: 'no detectable added value' is not proof of zero KD benefit; bootstrap resamples queries after seed averaging and does not measure the full training-seed uncertainty. P5's Science report attributed H6b improvement to query exposure, but this causal attribution is a hypothesis, not a measured explanation.
audit.split_integrity: C5 previously exposed SciFact 200-query holdout is spent. C6 FiQA/NFCorpus frozen official 648/323 test used once after training. audit.cost: C6 200k teacher scores and reported ~10.58 GPU-hours are not total end-to-end costs; FiQA seven-way scoring alone consumed 5,786 GPU-seconds and failed/duplicate work needs accounting. P5 B3R 5-label set-aware used 1,252,556 teacher input tokens vs random 971,006. P5 Wave2 ~$0.29659 metered Modal GPU/CPU inference and 25.1min local CPU.
audit.novelty: Both original Claude Science sessions now explicitly reject the teacher-budget / set-aware allocation framing as a demonstrated top-tier method. P1 proposes an equal-query-exposure teacher-vs-self-training mechanism check only if reopened; this overlaps GPL/active selection. P5 recommends first auditing validity of the gold-support metric against human-reviewed sufficient evidence sets; alternative evidence is not yet verified and 28.5% answer-string overlap does not by itself prove gold labels are wrong. No credible new contribution established.

independent_caveats: A CI including 0 does not establish equivalence or zero benefit.
P1 training used three seeds; query-bootstrap CI omits training-seed variability.
C6 H6b does not isolate teacher-content value from exposure and a weak G10 baseline; G10 overfitting is plausible but unverified.
P5 B3R teacher cost at b=5 is not matched; direct method-vs-random superiority cannot be claimed.
Answer-string overlap is not proof of alternative sufficient evidence; an independent sufficiency audit is required.
No full-paper novelty, human-audited metric-validity result or independent replication yet.
